posts.cooked:
We get 5 updates this month.  This one's about the Collector's case again (meh) but there are some content reveals:

  • The Collector's Case shows the updated difficulties (e.g. Ambuscade and Chokepoint as difficulty 1).  Still not perfect (Kaargra is still a 3), but better than the original estimates.
  • The 10th Scion's name comes between Progeny and Sanction in alphabetical order.
  • Environments have official difficulties (1-3).  Most of them are 2's, though.  Out of the new ones, Maerynian Refuge is a 1 and Mordengrad is a 3.

posts.name: dprcooke
posts.cooked:
@Belle Sorciere

That's totally reasonable.

I can't say that I'm not disappointed that I didn't have this in January, but what's making me okay with it is that I also know that GTG is actually working on it, and that the game and case I'll be getting will be better because of the extra time.  I seem to remember someone commenting (on the KS I think) who had playtested the scenario 2 (though maybe just 1?) years ago at GenCon.  At the time, the OblivAeon fight was confusing, had a ton of moving bits, and took 4+ hours to play.  From the observations out of this years' GenCon it's a <=2 hour hour game that's much more streamlined.  I want the 2nd of those 2 games, even if it means I have to wait longer.  And as someone who ordered the case, I appreciate them going through half a million iterations to get something that will last.

That's not to say I'm willing to give GTG a total free pass, but maybe I just have more patience?  When I look through the list of projects I've either Kickstarted (8) or pre-ordered (another 3-4), almost every single one of those was at least 1 month late (the average is probably 4-5 months), then there's Tactics/Prime War, a different project that is over 2 years past the estimated delivery and no where close to delivering, and finally one project that shut down and will not be delivering period.  I think only 1 project (a game matt which literally only needed to be printed) actually delivered on time.

The amazing preview pictures aren't helping me be patient (because holy crap that looks awesome and I want it yesterday!), but holy crap that looks awesome and I'm going to get it at some point!
